subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Davie would be well away, for he would __**fret **__about his grandmother, and that would do neither of them any good.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fret"** means to worry or be anxious about something. (चिंता करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She would** fret **about the smallest details before any big event.
 
 
 
• **"Delight"** refers to a feeling of great pleasure or happiness. (आनंद)
 
 
• **Example: **The children were filled with **delight **when they saw the amusement park.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fret'** is **'delight'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agonize **(पीड़ा में होना): To undergo great mental anguish through worrying about something.

 
 
• **Example:** He would **agonize** over every small decision.
 
 
 
• **Bother **(परेशान करना): To take the trouble to do something or to cause worry or irritation.
 
 
• **Example: **Don't** bother **about the mess, I'll clean it up later.
 
 
 
• **Carp** (नुक़्स निकालना): To complain or find fault continually about trivial matters.
 
 
• **Example:** She tends to **carp** about every little thing, which can be quite annoying.
 
 

37:Tc04,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
